'''Leaf Forest''' (Japanese: '''リーフの森''' ''Leaf Forest'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive [[forest]] in [[Kanto]], featured in ''[[EP043|The March of the Exeggutor Squad]]''. It is located between the {{safari|Kanto}} and [[Cinnabar Island]]. It has a large population of {{p|Exeggutor}}. The area functions similar to a [[Leaf Stone]], causing some species of {{type|Grass}} Pokémon to [[Evolution|evolve]] without warning.
